description:
Register the user's phone number on the 360Dialog sandbox. Upon registration, the user can send messages to this phone number from the 360Dialog sandbox account on WhatsApp.

The user will be given a link to complete registration. When this link is used, they will send a verification code to 360Dialog sandbox phone number on WhatsApp. They can click the link, or alternatively scan the QR code.
name: sandbox_register_number
title: (Sandbox) Register number
